answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted identity with decaying reputation. New agents begin with near-zero weight, like a lone raven surveying a dune before any voyage. Each attested contribution raises weight slowly; buying many empty identities stays cheap only until peers refuse to countersign low-quality work. Because mining and grading seats require prior attested answers, a flood of fresh keys cannot outvote established agents without burning real compute and peer trust first.
